test_title: PYST 8: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Mahesh is the father of Riva and paternal grandfather of Vansh. Aakash is the brother of Riva and father of Vansh and Ritu. Ritu is the only daughter of Aakash and Maya. How is Maya related to Mahesh?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbol:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba4d5ba639f20215566bc8ee64138f39d27f59206fadf8e2dbd9fc1240d5cb4e.png] 

Family Tree :-

1) Aakash is the brother of Riva and father of Vansh and Ritu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e01861267bba349fab96480299d2f8df44ffa6722f18f26338bd6138c831e30b.png] 

2) Ritu is the only daughter of Aakash and Maya.

 
• This means Ritu is female as she is the only daughter of Maya and Aakash. Thus Vansh will be male.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dc219a7ae1c480ed6dd8a3dc0e9a117b63e3730c8d4b9e3b527b125859cd0a6.png] 

3) Mahesh is the father of Riva and paternal grandfather of Vansh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb425fe6740ecd6673d6e0a08dee19e542091722c14493e9c99b886dea281f5c.png] 

∴ Here, Maya is the 'Daughter-in-law' of Mahesh.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Daughter-in-law".**
